name: @kalisio/krawler-meteofrance
description: A Krawler job designed to scrape data from the Météo-France public API

scripts.build:arome-france: cross-env DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 cross-env-shell docker build --build-arg KRAWLER_TAG=$(node -p "require('./package.json').krawler.version") -t krawler-meteofrance:arome-france-${TAG:-latest} -f $PWD/dockerfile.arome-france $PWD/../..
